claims.gist: Wiz Code is the best CNAPP offering, better than legacy scanners but short of modern ASPMs
Wiz Code adds repo-level SCA, IaC and secrets scanning through a GitHub app
Pipelineless scanning through a GitHub integration is genuinely good
SCA without reachability, SBOM generation and IaC scanning are not impressive new features
Rollup, reachability and malware detail separate noisy scanners from fixable findings
Wiz has a real shot at pulling off the CNAPP nightmare
Wiz's data architecture and UX give it an advantage others will find hard to match
I have taken $0 from any CNAPP provider

thesis: Wiz Code is a good CNAPP offering with pipelineless scanning, but its AppSec depth falls short of modern ASPMs.
